The '''''Sky Yards''-class Herdship''' was a class of [[Ithorian Herdship]].

==Characteristics==
The design was similar to the [[Manollium-class herdship|''Manollium''-class Herdship]], but was made exclusively by the Ithorian-based corporation [[Ithorian SkyYards/Legends|Ithorian SkyYards]].
